name: tutoring
description: Tutors help students with school subjects one on one, paid per hour, in person or online.

description.description: The help offered, or the help looked for.

payment.description: How a session may be paid: direct, session, or both.

subjects.description: The school subjects, such as maths or chemistry.

levels.description: The school levels: primary, secondary, university.

place.description: Where sessions are held, or online. A tutor who does both writes two posts.

howDealsGo: The tutor and the student, or a parent for a child, agree in messages on the subject, the times and the place, and pay outside Forest. After a session each may review the other. A review of the person who wrote the post names it.
